name: 26101 · Parkersburg, WV
findings: ZIP 26101 (Parkersburg) has 164 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 26101 (Parkersburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 22 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 16% of all organizations here have no identified type.
